column1: # Creative attributes, coded by eye from the images in this directory.
# The attribute list was fixed BEFORE the images were opened (see sample_creative.py) so the
# coding could not become a search for a story. `aspect` is machine-read from the scrape metadata
# and is not a judgement. Everything else is one reader's judgement, and no second reader has
# 20 of the 36 images are coded. The other 16 need no key and no credit, only reading.
# kind        what the image mainly is
# face        is there a human face at a size the feed can read
# type_role   message = the type carries the point; decor = the type labels a link; none
# brand       is the company's own colour/type system doing work in the image
# shows       evidence = something that happened or a measurable; claim = an assertion
# defect      anything visibly wrong at feed size
